1	# Swarm guide
2	
3	One process, one asyncio loop, many agents. Agents share a **blackboard**; the **orchestrator** runs them in phases.
4	Each person owns **one file in `agents/`** (no merge conflicts); shared code is in `swarm/` (change it by PR, small).
5	
6	```
7	COLLECT (dataflow: scrapers + analysts, synchronised by done flags)  ->  VERIFY  ->  COMPUTE (plain code)  ->  SUBMIT
8	 scrapers save pages the MODEL chose; analysts turn them into results                                        enter bid, sign TAN
9	```
10	
11	## Data flow (who waits for what)
12	
13	```
14	BriefReader ──> results["brief"] (reference, scenario date, bidder, authorised senders), results["sites"] (role -> siteId)
15	TenderScraper (b0) login + overview, then documents (main tab) || Q&A (2nd tab)
16	                   ──tender.page──> done.tender ──> QuantityAnalyzer ──> results["tender"], results["quantities"]
17	SpecScraper   (b1) ──spec.page───> done.spec ───> RequirementAnalyzer ──> results["spec"], results["requirements"]
18	                                                        (+ Q&A amendments) ──> results["requirements_final"]
19	ErpScraper    (b2) logs in while waiting for results["requirements"]; then small jobs on up to ERP_TABS tabs: one
20	                   search per catalogue group -> the listed materials that fit -> record -> prices || stock per active material
21	                   ──erp.page──> done.erp ──> MaterialMatcher ──> results["erp"], results["materials"]
22	MailScraper   (b3) logs in while the brief is read; one search for the reference, reads every message about the tender
23	                   ──> done.mail_core; then a search per brief topic still without a valid message (parallel tabs)
24	                   ──> done.mail ──mail.page──> DiscountAnalyzer ──> results["discount"], results["mail"], results["mailbox"]
25	CollectionCoordinator (reasoning model) as each site's first pass + analysis is done: code lists the gaps (facts the
26	                   bid needs that no saved page holds), the model turns them into focused follow-up jobs on that site,
27	                   the affected analyses run again ──> results["gaps"] (what is still open when COLLECT ends)
28	PopupGuard (next to every browse): clears cookie banners, surveys, notices, error pages, access gates
29	EvidenceVerifier ──> results["verification"];  BidCalculator ──> results["bid"], results["answer"]
30	BidSubmitter (b0 main tab, full reasoning; TAN via a short browse on b3's main tab) ──> results["submission"]
31	```
32	
33	Every scraper sets its `done.<role>` flag in a `finally`, so analysts never wait forever; every wait has a timeout
34	bounded by `ctx.time_left()`. Missing inputs degrade the bid (omitted positions, blank breakdown fields), never crash it.
35	
36	## Files
37	
38	| Path | What |
39	| --- | --- |
40	| `swarm/blackboard.py` | `Evidence(kind, site, data, source, author, note)`, `Blackboard` (post/query/set/get/wait_for/dump/load) |
41	| `swarm/agent.py` | `Agent` base, `Phase`, `@register` |
42	| `swarm/context.py` | `ctx`: `task`, `board`, `llm`, `pool`, `site(id)`, `brief`, `time_left()`, `seconds_left()`, `lock(name)`, `shared` |
43	| `swarm/llm.py` | `ctx.llm.chat / ask / ask_json` (Qwen, concurrency-limited, usage counted), `parse_json` |
44	| `swarm/browser_agent.py` | `browse(ctx, goal, browser=n, tab=..., flash=..., careful=...)`: **browser-use** on our CDP browser + Qwen, with our actions `read_page`, `record`, `fill_form`, `share_tip`, `read_document`, `read_visual`; `Tab` |
45	| `swarm/guard.py` | `PopupGuard`: runs next to every browsing agent and clears noise (model decides once per kind of popup, cached per site) |
46	| `swarm/page_text.py` | the page extractor behind `read_page` (iframes, collapsed sections, tooltips, canvas labels, zero-width chars) |
47	| `swarm/forms.py` | the form filler behind `fill_form` (cascading selects via an apply button) |
48	| `swarm/extract.py` | analyst helpers: saved pages -> model extraction with a JSON shape (chunked, merged) |
49	| `swarm/normalize.py` | numbers (de-DE/en-US), dates (MM/DD vs DD/MM, ISO), references, German display format, cent rounding |
50	| `swarm/sites.py` | role -> siteId mapping (site names differ per dataset) |
51	| `swarm/scraper.py` | `SiteScraper`: set `role`, `browser`, write `goal()`; `self.browse(job)` for extra passes, `self.browse_in_tabs(jobs)` for parallel ones; `run_job(ctx, role, job)` for the coordinator |
52	| `swarm/orchestrator.py` | discovery of `agents/*`, phases, timeouts, failure isolation, board dumps |
53	| `agents/*.py` | the agents. Header comment of each file: OWNER / ROLE / NEEDS / WRITES and the result shapes |
54	
55	## How the model browses
56	
57	The model (Qwen via browser-use) decides where to go. Three actions of ours make it fast and exact:
58	
59	- `read_page(url?, topic?, next_page_link?)`: full text of the page it chose (hidden-but-real content included,
60	  decoys hidden from people excluded); with `next_page_link` it reads every page of a paged list; with `topic` the
61	  text is saved as Evidence `"<role>.page"` for the analysts. This is "extract a selected page / paginate a
62	  model-selected result set" from the rules: the model selects, the helper extracts.
63	- `record(kind, data, source, note)`: one fact.
64	- `fill_form(fields, apply_button?, then_click?)`: many fields of a form in one step (bid configurator). Also custom
65	  toggles without an input (shadow DOM), named by their text; sliders set to 'max' are dragged with real mouse events.
66	  (browser-use's `evaluate` is off: writing page JavaScript cost whole step budgets.)
67	- `share_tip(tip)`: a short how-to for the site (a URL pattern that opens results directly, how a record opens); later
68	  agents on that site get the tips in their hints, so one agent's discovery saves every other agent the search.
69	
70	`read_page` reads live content by default and preserves URL fragments. Explicit `refresh=false` permits cached
71	immutable evidence. Failed extractions are retried rather than cached as empty results. The popup guard (`swarm/guard.py`) sweeps the agent's page before every step and every 2 s:
72	each new kind of dialog / overlay / banner / short error page goes to Clef, then Qwen if needed, once ("click" noise, "fill" an access
73	gate, "leave" anything an agent works with), and the decision is cached per site for all agents, so a notice that comes
74	back on every page costs one model call per run. The submitter's guard is careful: clicks on noise without inputs only.
75	The guard owns every block; explorers never interact with one. It sweeps right before each step AND right before
76	each page action (`GuardedTools.act`): when it had to clear something that appeared after the model looked, the
77	action is not executed and the model gets a short note ("not executed: a gate covered the page; look again"), with
78	its memory intact. Gates: sliders/checkboxes are filled from the cached decision; a gate asking for a typed code
79	(receipt number drawn in a canvas) is read by Qwen from a screenshot (`read_code`) and filled completely, or not at
80	all - a continue button is never pressed with a typed field empty (that spent the ERP form 9x in
81	reh_cabb68e26f532fb8). One gate submission per site at a time (`gate:<host>` lock, tabs share the session). The
82	background loop clicks noise only, and never while an agent action runs. The sweep before a step waits up to
83	`SWARM_GUARD_SETTLE_S` for items still being classified. An agent passes a gate itself only if it survives 2 steps.
84	`report_site_capability present=false` caused by login/gate/error trouble is refused (Clef check), so an access
85	failure never unassigns a site.
86	Links that open another page ("accept and continue" in notices, "Öffnen" in download bars) are never clicked: when the
87	model picks one, the item's single staying button (its x) is used instead; only an error page's retry link may lead
88	away. Inline gates (a slider to drag to the end, a robot checkbox) are found by their slider and unlocked on every
89	page; fills that only tick boxes and move sliders are cached like clicks. `read_page` prints list links as `<url>`, so
90	agents open records and messages by URL instead of clicking through locked or paged lists.
91	
92	Analysts then ask the model to extract a JSON shape from the saved text (`swarm/extract.py`) and apply the brief's
93	rules in code (latest dated record wins, withdrawn answers ignored, exact reference, authorised sender, ...).
94	
95	### Which model does what
96	
97	| Clef (`swarm/decide.py`: closed choice / yes-no, cheap) | Qwen (`swarm/llm.py`, browser-use: writes text and values) |
98	| --- | --- |
99	| guard triage: kind of popup + which button clears it, "leave" for content | every browsing step (navigation, forms, the bid wizard) |
100	| site-role mapping (one choice per role, kept at confidence >= 0.85) | page extraction to JSON, brief facts, read_visual transcription |
101	| receipt sanity check in `confirm_submission` (blocks only a clear "no") | follow-up planning (coordinator, thinking on), gate field values |
102	
103	Every Clef use falls back to Qwen (guard items Clef is unsure about, access gates, unmapped roles) or to the old
104	behaviour (receipt check) when Clef is missing, slow or not confident, so local runs without Clef work unchanged.
105	
106	## Contracts (agree before changing)
107	
108	Evidence kinds: `<role>.page` (data: topic, url, title, pages, text) for saved pages; `record` kinds as the scraper's
109	goal names them (e.g. `mail.tan`). Results keys and shapes are documented at the top of each agent file.
110	Done flags: `done.tender`, `done.spec`, `done.erp`, `done.mail_core`, `done.mail`, `requirements_final`, `mail_final`.
111	Analysts expose `refresh(ctx)` (module level): re-run on the pages saved so far (ERP and mail pages are extracted once
112	each and cached), so the coordinator can update results after its follow-up jobs.
113	
114	## Local development
115	
116	```powershell
117	atira models proxy                                   # terminal 1
118	atira scout --env | Out-String | Invoke-Expression   # terminal 2
119	uv run --no-sync python agent.py                     # whole swarm; dumps .swarm/board.json after each phase
120	$env:SWARM_DEADLINE_S="1200"                         # optional: simulate the 20-minute clock locally
121	$env:SWARM_ONLY="MaterialMatcher,BidCalculator"; $env:SWARM_BOARD_IN=".swarm/board.json"
122	uv run --no-sync python agent.py                     # only these agents, on a saved board (no re-scraping)
123	uv run --no-sync python -m unittest discover -s tests -q
124	```
125	`SWARM_BOARD_IN` is ignored in scored runs. `.swarm/` holds scouting data: git-ignored, never ship it.
126	Replaying analysts on a saved board: the done flags are in the board, so waits return immediately.
127	
128	## Time budget (20-minute run)
129	
130	Collecting/analysing stops `ctx.submit_reserve()` seconds before expiry, then VERIFY/COMPUTE (instant) and SUBMIT,
131	which stops `FINAL_MARGIN_S` (40 s) before expiry. The reserve is estimated live: (wizard steps + 2.5 steps per
132	position (3 steps each), minus the steps WizardPrep already did) x max(13 s, measured median browsing step x 1.15) +
133	TAN lookup + safety, clamped to [390, 600] s (calibrated on sandbox signings: 12-13 s per submitter step). `SWARM_SUBMIT_RESERVE_S` > 0 fixes it. The collect cutoff and every browse's stop mark
134	follow the live value (re-checked each second / before each step).
135	
136	## Where the time goes (swarm/timeline.py, scripts/timeline.py)
137	
138	Spans per agent: `browse.step`, `model.queue` (waiting for a slot), `model.call`, `extract`, `wait.dep` (an agent
139	waiting for an upstream result), `recovery` (browser checks, hung tabs, failed model attempts), `guard`, `browse.failed`;
140	counters for repeated work (`reads.repeat`, `browse.retries`, `erp.focused`, `browse.crashed`, ...); milestones (first
141	page per site, first requirements, first usable bid, each position complete, wizard ready, collect end, submit start,
142	TAN requested/received, entries checked, accepted submission). The run log gets a `progress` line per minute and five
143	`TIMELINE` lines at the end (the platform keeps only the log's tail); local runs also write `.swarm/timeline.json`.
144	`scripts/timeline.py <saved log>` rebuilds a timeline from any run log, old or new.
145	
146	## Coordination (what no longer waits)
147	
148	- `BidDrafter` recomputes the bid every 3 s during collection (`results["bid_draft"]`); the submitter falls back to it.
149	- `compute()` names an open dependency for every omitted position and estimated field (`dependencies`, `unresolved`,
150	  per-line `fields` status: verified / absent / estimated / missing). The coordinator turns those into gaps too, so a
151	  condition without a price unit is a gap, not "no gaps". Mail gaps start 30 s after the index pass was analysed; a site
152	  with follow-ups running takes new, different gaps (max 2 at once per site); an unchanged gap set is re-planned only
153	  after 45 s.
154	- ERP: the next job is chosen when a tab is free: focused re-reads of what the calculation misses, then prices/stock of
155	  materials that already match a position, then searches and the best candidate per requirement, then other
156	  candidates; candidates of already matched positions last. Extraction runs in the background (the tab moves on).
157	- Analysts extract each page in its own task (`swarm.extract.start_once`): a new page never waits for a slow batch.
158	- Price conditions: `reconcile_conditions` merges pages of one record only (same record id, linked page URLs, or a
159	  single dated condition); conflicting reads become `_conflict` (unpriced, a gap), unrelated fragments stay apart.
160	
161	## Recovery
162	
163	- A hung-tab check closes only the caller's tab, unowned tabs and idle owned tabs, never another agent's active tab;
164	  a healthy browser is not re-checked within 20 s. A hung own tab is renewed in place (main tabs stay main tabs).
165	- A tab that hangs again on the same browser within 5 min continues in a new tab of another responsive browser.
166	- A crashed browse returns an unfinished result (its pages are already saved); `browse_until_done` retries with the
167	  saved topics instead of losing the scraper.
168	- A collection browse that saved pages and then saves nothing for 10 steps ends (decoys, dead ends); the caller resumes.
169	- Browsing model calls time out after 35 s (`SWARM_BROWSE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_S`) instead of 55 s.
170	- The platform ends the run when the binding submission goes through; model calls then answer 401 "finished or
171	  expired run token". With time left and a TAN requested, that counts as acceptance (no false failure, no retries).
172	- ERP uses 6 tabs (`SWARM_ERP_TABS`): in an A/B with the same code, 6 tabs completed 17 ERP jobs vs 12 and priced
173	  4 positions vs 1, without more failed browses.
174	
175	## Submission
176	
177	`WizardPrep` opens the bid wizard in browser 0's main tab near the end of collection (entering nothing); at submit
178	start the mail main tab logs in and opens the inbox (no search filter); `check_entries` compares the summary page
179	with the bid in code. `fill_form` prefers a real checkbox/switch over an `<output>` that echoes its text, and finds an
180	unlabelled checkbox by its neighbouring text (a shadow-DOM confirmation box once cost 3.5 signing minutes).
181	`RUN_LIMIT_S` (default 1200 s, env `SWARM_RUN_LIMIT_S`, 0 = off): every run plans with at most 20 minutes from process
182	start, so 2-hour test runs show the timing of a scored run.
183	
184	## Fair-play rules for everyone (a reviewer reads the package)
185	
186	- No scenario values anywhere (prices, material numbers, refs, logins, TANs, totals, dates, keys, transaction codes):
187	  not in prompts, hints, defaults, tests or notes. Tests use invented dummy data. Strategy is fine, values are not.
188	- The model decides where to go and what matters. Code may parse, page through model-selected results, validate,
189	  compute, fill forms. No fixed click paths, URL lists, or crawl-everything-then-one-prompt helpers.
190	- Only the provided CDP browsers; no extra Chromium; no hosts besides the platform and the 4 sites; models via the proxy.
191	- Do not write comments addressed to the reviewer.
192	
193	## Robustness settings (learned from the first sandbox runs)
194	
195	- No screenshots per step (`TextSession`): in the sandbox they stalled every step for 30 s. `read_page` covers canvas text.
196	- No browser-use loading animation: it loads a logo from an external host the sandbox cannot reach, which left the tab
197	  "loading" and every navigation in that browser timing out. `RobustSession` also stops a stuck load and retries once.
198	- Qwen's separate reasoning pass is off and replies are forced to a JSON object (`QwenChat`, `LLM.ask_json`): steps
199	  went from 10-75 s to a few seconds and the "invalid JSON / prose reply" failures stop.
200	- Scrapers, ERP items and the submitter retry an agent that stopped early, telling it what is already saved.
201	- Requirements are published early (as soon as a requirement table page is saved) so the ERP work starts sooner.
202	
203	## Speed (each browsing step is one model call of ~14 s, most of it queue wait: fewer sequential steps = faster)
204	
205	- Parallel tabs: the 4-browser limit does not limit tabs. Independent jobs run in tabs of their own (`Tab`,
206	  `browse_in_tabs`); tabs of one browser share its login cookies (most sites; the webmail asks each tab to log in).
207	  New tabs open next to the others in the browser's window (`TAB_WINDOWS=1`: a window each) and close when their job
208	  ends. An agent sees only its own tab and unowned ones (popups), never another agent's tab. Rule: one browse() per
209	  tab at a time.
210	- Every agent tab has focus emulation on: only one window/tab has the real focus, and without it typing and
211	  focus-dependent page scripts silently did nothing in the others.
212	- Lifecycle events are routed per tab (browser-use's single per-client handler dropped other tabs' load events, so
213	  each navigation in a second tab waited 3-8 s). A tab's later jobs continue from its current page.
214	- Flash mode for navigating/extracting agents (default): replies are memory + actions only, with a compact system
215	  prompt (~0.6k instead of ~5k tokens) and a 2000-token reply cap. The bid submitter keeps full reasoning (`flash=False`).
216	- Unused browser-use actions (web search, LLM extract, screenshots, file system, uploads) are excluded: smaller schema
217	  in every prompt, and no wasted steps on them.
218	- Prompt text (goals, hints, rules, tool descriptions) is written tersely: every word is resent on every step.
219	- Small jobs instead of big ones: an ERP job per search / material record / prices / stock finishes inside its step
220	  budget, and materials the search list already rules out are never opened.
221	- Logs: browser-use's own step logs are off (the platform keeps only the tail of a run's log, and they pushed the
222	  swarm's lines out); `browse` logs one line per step, and the board is summarised in one line after COLLECT.
223	
224	## Work split (3 people) and how to iterate on your part
225	
226	| Person | Agents | Iterate with |
227	| --- | --- | --- |
228	| A: tender + spec | `scrape_tender`, `scrape_spec`, `analyze_quantities`, `analyze_requirements` | `SWARM_ONLY=TenderScraper,QuantityAnalyzer` live; analysts on a saved board |
229	| B: ERP | `scrape_erp` (ErpScraper + its tab workers), `analyze_materials` | `SWARM_ONLY=ErpScraper,MaterialMatcher` on a board that has `requirements` |
230	| C: mail + shared | `scrape_mail`, `analyze_discount`, `compute_bid`, `submit_bid`, `swarm/*` | analysts/calculator on a saved board; `tests/test_rules.py` |
231	
232	Loop: run your scraper live once -> it dumps `.swarm/board.json` -> replay your analyst on it as often as needed
233	(`SWARM_BOARD_IN`) -> check the result keys -> tune the goal/hints (strategy only) or the extraction shape -> repeat.
234	Then a sandbox test run (`atira test-run .`) to check timing; debug with `atira logs <run>`.
235	
236	## Open items
237	
238	- Tune goals/hints per site from test-run logs (`atira` MCP: `run_logs`, `run_llm_calls`, `run_screenshot`).
239	- Submitter: watch the first real runs closely (wizard order, TAN timing).
240	- Cost: browser-use sends the goal every step; keep goals short.
241	
242	
243	## Workflow safeguards and evaluation
244	
245	Requirements are published as specification pages arrive; ERP keeps accepting new requirements until final analysis.
246	Mail stops 150 seconds before the submission reserve, and every completed mail/ERP extraction is retained immediately.
247	At the collection cutoff the orchestrator reconciles completed extractions without another model call.
248	
249	Model attempts time out after 55 seconds (`SWARM_MODEL_TIMEOUT_S`); browsing and analyst calls share a concurrency
250	limit of 16. A run has its own monotonic clock. Collection children and guard tasks are cancelled and awaited before
251	signing. Local runs launch persistent CDP browsers so a resumed wizard keeps its tab and login.
252	
253	The submitter starts a background TAN lookup and polls it while retaining the portal wizard. A replacement request
254	explicitly invalidates that lookup. A model `done` result is insufficient: `confirm_submission` must match a quoted
255	receipt on the tender portal. Missing confirmation produces a failed run rather than a misleading success exit.
256	
257	Open shadow roots, visible editable controls, PDF/text/ZIP documents, and explicit visual transcription have helper
258	support. Failed or unverified form fields prevent the helper's continue click. These mechanisms do not guarantee
259	compatibility with every framework or website. [The review backlog](REVIEW.md) distinguishes fixes from remaining
260	risks; `scripts/evaluate_navigation.py` runs an opt-in live-model discovery check against two synthetic layouts.
261	
262	Tender positions and Q&A now publish independently as each extraction completes. Specification pages are cached and
263	merged in observed order; late Q&A is reapplied to original revision facts. The default submission reserve is eight
264	minutes. Connection establishment has an eight-second timeout; browsing clients are reused within a job and closed
265	when it ends. The runtime capability-report tool can invalidate a previously complete site mapping.

1	"""Base class for site scrapers: a model-driven browse of ONE site that streams Evidence onto the blackboard.
2	
3	Subclass, set `role` ('tender' | 'spec' | 'erp' | 'mail') and `browser`, and write `goal()` (what the model should
4	find, in general terms derived from the brief; never scenario values). The site id for the role is resolved at run
5	time (datasets name their sites differently). Override `run()` for several browse passes; call `self.browse(goal)`.
6	
7	When the scraper ends (done, failed or out of time) it sets results[f"done.{role}"] so analysts waiting on it start.
8	Independent jobs run at once with `browse_in_tabs` (one new tab each, closed when its job ends); `self.browse` works
9	in the browser's main tab.
10	"""
11	import asyncio
12	
13	from swarm import timeline
14	from swarm.agent import Agent, Phase
15	from swarm.blackboard import Evidence
16	from swarm.browser_agent import Tab, browse
17	from swarm.extract import brief_intro
18	from swarm.sites import site_for
19	
20	ANALYSIS_RESERVE_S = 75     # scrapers stop browsing this long before collecting ends (analysts need the time)
21	IDLE_STEPS = 10             # a collection browse that saved pages, then saves nothing for this many steps, ends
22	
23	
24	class SiteScraper(Agent):
25	    phase = Phase.COLLECT
26	    role: str = ""
27	    site_id: str = ""
28	    max_steps: int = 40
29	    hints: str = ""
30	
31	    def goal(self) -> str:
32	        raise NotImplementedError
33	
34	    def login_text(self) -> str:
35	        site = self.ctx.site(self.site_id)
36	        creds = site.get("credentials") or {}
37	        return f"Site ({self.role}): {site['url']}\nLogin: username {creds.get('username')!r}, password {creds.get('password')!r}"
38	
39	    def task_text(self) -> str:
40	        facts = self.ctx.board.get("brief") or {}
41	        known = {k: facts.get(k) for k in ("tender_reference", "tender_title", "buyer", "scenario_date", "bidder_company")
42	                 if facts.get(k)}
43	        return f"CONTEXT:\n{brief_intro(self.ctx.brief)}\nKey facts: {known}" if known else \
44	            f"CONTEXT:\n{brief_intro(self.ctx.brief)}"
45	
46	    async def post(self, rec: dict) -> None:
47	        kind = f"{self.role}.page" if rec["kind"] == "page" else rec["kind"]
48	        await self.ctx.board.post(Evidence(kind=kind, site=self.site_id, data=rec["data"], source=rec["source"],
49	                                           author=self.name, note=rec["note"]))
50	        if kind.endswith(".page"):
51	            timeline.mark(f"first {kind}")
52	
53	    def stop_extra(self, kwargs: dict) -> float:
54	        return kwargs.get("stop_extra", ANALYSIS_RESERVE_S)
55	
56	    async def browse(self, job: str, *, browser: int | None = None, max_steps: int | None = None, **kwargs) -> dict:
57	        prompt = "\n\n".join([self.login_text(), self.task_text(), f"YOUR JOB:\n{job}"])
58	        # stop browsing early enough for the analysts to turn the last pages into results before collecting ends
59	        kwargs.setdefault("stop_extra", ANALYSIS_RESERVE_S)
60	        kwargs.setdefault("idle_steps", IDLE_STEPS)
61	        out = await browse(self.ctx, prompt, browser=self.browser if browser is None else browser, site_id=self.site_id,
62	                           on_record=self.post, max_steps=max_steps or self.max_steps, hints=self.hints,
63	                           author=kwargs.pop("author", self.name), **kwargs)
64	        self.log.info("browse done in %d steps, %d records: %s", out["steps"], len(out["records"]), out["summary"][:300])
65	        return out
66	
67	    def time_for_retry(self, kwargs: dict, need: float = 120) -> bool:
68	        stop = kwargs["stop_reserve"] if kwargs.get("stop_reserve") is not None else self.ctx.stop_at(self.stop_extra(kwargs))
69	        return self.ctx.seconds_left() - stop >= need
70	
71	    async def browse_until_done(self, job: str, attempts: int = 3, **kwargs) -> dict:
72	        """browse(); if the agent stopped without finishing (errors, step limit, a crashed browser agent), start again
73	        with a note on what is already saved, while time allows. Saved pages are never collected twice."""
74	        out = {"summary": "", "done": False}
75	        records = []
76	        for attempt in range(attempts):
77	            note = ""
78	            if attempt:
79	                saved = sorted({e.data.get("topic") for e in self.ctx.board.query(f"{self.role}.page")} - {None})
80	                note = (f"\n\nNOTE: previous attempt stopped early ({out['summary'][:300]!r}). Already saved: "
81	                        f"{saved or 'nothing'}. Do only what is missing.")
82	                timeline.count("browse.retries")
83	            try:
84	                out = await self.browse(job + note, **kwargs)
85	            except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - a failed connection is one failed attempt, not the end
86	                self.ctx.board.error(self.name, f"browse attempt {attempt + 1}: {type(error).__name__}: {error}")
87	                self.log.warning("browse attempt %d failed: %s", attempt + 1, error)
88	                out = {"summary": f"failed: {type(error).__name__}", "done": False, "records": [], "steps": 0}
89	            records.extend(out.get("records") or [])
90	            rejected = self.ctx.shared.get("site_invalidations", {}).get(self.role, set())
91	            if self.site_id in rejected:
92	                self.site_id = await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
93	                # A reused tab may still show the old application; runtime model navigates the newly assigned URL.
94	                job += "\nThe prior site assignment was contradicted. Navigate to the newly assigned site URL in Login."
95	                out["done"] = False
96	            if out["done"] or not self.time_for_retry(kwargs):
97	                break
98	        return {**out, "records": records}
99	
100	    async def browse_in_tabs(self, jobs: list[str], *, browser: int | None = None, attempts: int = 2,
101	                             **kwargs) -> list[dict]:
102	        """Run `jobs` at once, each in a new tab of this scraper's browser (the tabs share its login cookies). Each tab
103	        is closed as soon as its job ends, so no tab sits idle. A failed job returns {"summary": error, "done": False}."""
104	        async def one(job: str) -> dict:
105	            tab = Tab(self.browser if browser is None else browser)
106	            try:
107	                return await self.browse_until_done(job, attempts=attempts, tab=tab, **kwargs)
108	            except Exception as error:
109	                self.ctx.board.error(self.name, f"tab job failed: {error}")
110	                return {"summary": str(error), "done": False}
111	            finally:
112	                await tab.close()
113	        return list(await asyncio.gather(*(one(job) for job in jobs)))
114	
115	    async def wait_brief(self, timeout: float = 180) -> dict:
116	        try:
117	            return await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="brief", timeout=timeout) or {}
118	        except TimeoutError:
119	            return {}
120	
121	    def required(self) -> list[tuple[tuple[str, ...], str]]:
122	        """Pages that must be saved, as (topic keywords, focused job). After the main browse, a focused browse runs
123	        for each one whose keywords appear in no saved topic. Override per scraper."""
124	        return []
125	
126	    def saved_topics(self) -> str:
127	        return " | ".join(str(e.data.get("topic", "")).lower() for e in self.ctx.board.query(f"{self.role}.page"))
128	
129	    async def run(self) -> None:
130	        try:
131	            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
132	            out = await self.browse_until_done(self.goal())   # the brief's intro already names the tender: start at once
133	            await self.ctx.board.set(f"{self.name}.summary", out["summary"])
134	            await self.required_pass()
135	        finally:
136	            await self.ctx.board.set(f"done.{self.role}", True)
137	
138	    async def required_pass(self) -> None:
139	        for keywords, job in self.required():
140	            if self.ctx.time_left() > 90 and not any(k in self.saved_topics() for k in keywords):
141	                self.log.warning("nothing saved for %s: focused browse", keywords)
142	                await self.browse_until_done(job, attempts=1, max_steps=15)
143	
144	
145	def scraper_class(role: str) -> type[SiteScraper] | None:
146	    from swarm.agent import REGISTRY
147	    return next((c for c in REGISTRY if isinstance(c, type) and issubclass(c, SiteScraper) and c.role == role), None)
148	
149	
150	async def run_job(ctx, role: str, job: str, *, max_steps: int = 16, **kwargs) -> dict:
151	    """One follow-up job on the site of `role`, run by that role's scraper setup (login, hints, browser): in the
152	    browser's main tab when it is free (logged in already), else in a new tab. For agents/coordinate.py."""
153	    cls = scraper_class(role)
154	    if cls is None:
155	        raise KeyError(f"no scraper for role {role!r}")
156	    scraper = cls(ctx)
157	    scraper.name = f"{cls.__name__}.followup"
158	    scraper.site_id = await site_for(ctx, role)
159	    main = ctx.lock(f"main_tab.{scraper.browser}")
160	    if not main.locked():
161	        async with main:
162	            return await scraper.browse_until_done(job, attempts=1, max_steps=max_steps, **kwargs)
163	    return (await scraper.browse_in_tabs([job], attempts=1, max_steps=max_steps, **kwargs))[0]

122	    def __init__(self, ctx):
123	        super().__init__(ctx)

133	    # ---- queue ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
134	    def add(self, job: tuple, force: bool = False) -> bool:
135	        key = job[:2] if job[0] != "search" else ("search", job[1]["group"], repr(job[1]["requirements"]))
136	        if key in self.seen and not force:
137	            return False
138	        self.seen.add(key)
139	        self.pending += 1
140	        self.jobs.append((next(self._order), job))
141	        return True
142	
143	    def matched(self) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
144	        """material -> positions it currently matches (verified active exact match)."""
145	        out: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
146	        for pos, m in (self.ctx.board.get("materials") or {}).items():
147	            if m.get("material") and not m.get("unverified"):
148	                out.setdefault(norm_ref(m["material"]), []).append(pos)
149	        return out

151	    def positions_of(self, item: dict) -> list[str]:
152	        refs = {norm_ref(r.get("ref")) for r in item.get("requirements") or []}
153	        return [str(p.get("position")) for p in (self.ctx.board.get("tender") or {}).get("positions") or []
154	                if norm_ref(p.get("requirement_ref")) in refs]

156	    def priority(self, job: tuple) -> int:
157	        """What the job adds to a submit-ready answer (lower first)."""
158	        kind = job[0]
159	        if kind == "search":
160	            return SEARCH
161	        material, item = job[1], job[2]
162	        matched = self.matched()
163	        if len(job) > 3 and job[3]:                    # focused re-read of something the calculation misses
164	            return FOLLOWUP
165	        if kind in ("prices", "stock"):
166	            return FINISH if norm_ref(material) in matched else SPECULATIVE
167	        positions = self.positions_of(item)
168	        covered = {p for ps in matched.values() for p in ps}
169	        if positions and all(p in covered for p in positions):
170	            return COVERED
171	        return BEST_RECORD if self.rank.get(norm_ref(material), 0) == 0 else RECORD

173	    def take(self) -> tuple | None:
174	        if not self.jobs:
175	            return None
176	        best = min(self.jobs, key=lambda j: (self.priority(j[1]), j[0]))
177	        self.jobs.remove(best)

197	    def spawn(self, coro) -> None:

199	        self.pending += 1

239	        """One focused re-read when the calculation still misses something this kind of page should show."""
240	        if norm_ref(material) not in self.matched() or self.blocked(material):

251	        extra = ANALYSIS_TIME_S

266	    async def worker(self, tab: Tab | None) -> None:
267	        """Takes jobs until none is queued and no running job or extraction can add more (or time is up)."""
268	        try:
269	            while self.ctx.time_left() > 0:

271	                    # too late for a new job now, but the live reserve may shrink again (e.g. the wizard warm-up

8	class BrowserPool:
9	    def __init__(self, REDACTED):
10	        self._pw = REDACTED
11	        self._contexts: dict[int, object] = {}   # slot -> browser context
12	        self._local = []
13	
14	    async def prepare(self):
15	        """Give local runs the same persistent CDP/tab lifecycle as sandbox runs."""
16	        if self._pw is None or browsers.cdp_urls():
17	            return
18	        urls = []
19	        for _ in range(4):
20	            with socket.socket() as sock:
21	                sock.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
22	                port = sock.getsockname()[1]
23	            browser = await self._pw.chromium.launch(headless=os.environ.get("HEADLESS") == "1",
24	                                                    args=[f"--remote-debugging-port={port}"])
25	            self._local.append(browser)
26	            urls.append(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}")
27	        os.environ["CDP_URLS"] = json.dumps(urls)
28	
29	    async def close(self):
30	        if self._local:
31	            for browser in self._local:
32	                await browser.close()
33	            os.environ.pop("CDP_URLS", None)
34	            self._local.clear()
35	
36	    async def context(self, index: int = 0):
37	        n = len(browsers.cdp_urls())
38	        slot = index % n if n else 0             # locally everything shares one Chromium
39	        if slot not in self._contexts:
40	            _, page = await browsers.connect(self._pw, slot)
41	            self._contexts[slot] = page.context
42	        return self._contexts[slot]
43	
44	    async def new_page(self, index: int = 0):
45	        """A fresh tab in browser `index`; tabs are unlimited, browsers are not (max 4)."""
46	        return await (await self.context(index)).new_page()

318	class Tab:
319	    """One tab of browser `browser`, owned by one agent (one browse() at a time). `Tab(b)` is a new tab, opened at the
320	    first browse(); `main_tab(b)` is the tab the browser started with. Locally (no CDP) every browse() starts its own
321	    Chromium, so a Tab is only a label there."""
322	
323	    def __init__(self, browser: int, main: bool = False):
324	        self.browser, self.main = browser, main
325	        self.target_id: str | None = None
326	        self.popups: set[str] = set()   # tabs the page opened (window.open, target=_blank) and the agent went into
327	        self.used = False            # an agent worked here before: the next browse continues from the current page
328	        self.suspect = False         # the last browse here failed (state timeouts / exception): check it before reuse
329	        self.renewed = False         # its page was hung and closed: open() creates a new one (main tabs too)
330	        self.replacement: "Tab | None" = None   # work moved to another browser: closed together with this tab
331	
332	    def targets(self) -> set[str]:
333	        return set(self.popups) | ({self.target_id} if self.target_id else set())
334	
335	    def renew(self) -> None:
336	        """Forget a page that was closed as hung; the next browse opens a fresh tab (logged in via shared cookies)."""
337	        for target in self.targets():
338	            _OWNERS.pop(target, None)
339	        self.target_id, self.popups, self.used, self.renewed = None, set(), False, True
340	
341	    def claim(self, target_id: str) -> None:
342	        self.target_id = target_id
343	        _OWNERS[target_id] = self
344	
345	    def adopt(self, target_id: str) -> None:
346	        """A popup this tab's agent focused: it belongs to this tab from now on (hidden from other agents)."""
347	        if self.target_id and target_id != self.target_id and owner_of(target_id) in (None, self) \
348	                and target_id not in _OWNERS:
349	            _OWNERS[target_id] = self
350	            self.popups.add(target_id)
351	
352	    async def open(self) -> None:
353	        """Create the tab now (before the session connects) so no other agent ever sees it unowned."""
354	        if self.target_id or (self.main and not self.renewed) or not browsers.cdp_urls():
355	            return
356	        # Default: a background tab next to the others in the browser's window, so the live view's tab strip shows every
357	        # agent (focus emulation keeps typing and focus-dependent scripts working in it; Chrome only slows its timers).
358	        # TAB_WINDOWS=1: a window per tab instead (always the visible tab there, no timer slowdown, but windows hide
359	        # each other in the live view).
360	        params = {"url": "about:blank", "newWindow": True} if os.environ.get("TAB_WINDOWS") == "1" else \
361	            {"url": "about:blank", "background": True}
362	        made = await _with_cdp(self.browser, lambda c: c.send.Target.createTarget(params=params))
363	        self.claim(made["targetId"])
364	
365	    async def close(self) -> None:
366	        """Close the tab and the popups it adopted (the main tab itself stays open)."""
367	        if self.replacement is not None:
368	            replacement, self.replacement = self.replacement, None
369	            await replacement.close()
370	        targets = list(self.popups) + ([self.target_id] if self.target_id and not self.main else [])
371	        self.popups = set()
372	        if not self.main:
373	            self.target_id, self.used = None, False
374	        for target in targets:
375	            _OWNERS.pop(target, None)
376	        if not targets:
377	            return
378	        try:
379	            await _with_cdp(self.browser, lambda c: asyncio.gather(
380	                *(c.send.Target.closeTarget(params={"targetId": t}) for t in targets), return_exceptions=True))
381	        except Exception as error:      # already closed / browser gone
382	            log.debug("closing tab failed: %s", error)

389	async def browser_responds(browser: int, timeout: float = 12) -> bool:
390	    """Does browser `browser` answer over CDP at all? (A hung page once left a sandbox browser unreachable for the rest
391	    of the run; every reconnect then failed after 15 s.)"""
392	    if not browsers.cdp_urls():
393	        return True
394	    seen = _UNRESPONSIVE.get(browser)
395	    if seen is not None and time.monotonic() - seen < DEAD_FOR_S:
396	        return False

399	    except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - timeout, refused, closed: all mean "not usable now"
400	        _UNRESPONSIVE[browser] = time.monotonic()
401	        log.warning("browser %d does not respond (%s)", browser, type(error).__name__)
402	        return False
403	    _UNRESPONSIVE.pop(browser, None)
404	    return True

416	def may_close(target_id: str, mine: "Tab | None") -> bool:
417	    """A recovery check may close only the caller's own tab (and its popups), tabs nobody owns, and owned tabs no
418	    browse is using. Another agent's active tab is never touched: a slow page there is that agent's business (its own
419	    browse ends after repeated state timeouts and recovers itself); closing it destroyed healthy work in progress."""

424	async def close_hung_tabs(browser: int, keep: str | None = None, mine: "Tab | None" = None) -> list[str]:
425	    """Close the tabs of `browser` whose page no longer runs JavaScript. browser-use attaches to every tab when it
426	    connects; one hung tab made each connect time out after 15 s, although the browser itself still answered (two
427	    sandbox runs: the submitter failed 5 times that way). `keep` is never closed, nor another agent's active tab
428	    (`may_close`). Returns the closed target ids."""
429	    async def probe(client) -> list[str]:
430	        targets = (await client.send.Target.getTargets())["targetInfos"]
431	        pages = [t for t in targets if t.get("type") == "page" and t["targetId"] != keep
432	                 and may_close(t["targetId"], mine)]
433	
434	        async def hung(target) -> bool:
435	            try:
436	                async with asyncio.timeout(TAB_PROBE_S):
437	                    attached = await client.send.Target.attachToTarget(
438	                        params={"targetId": target["targetId"], "flatten": True})
439	                    await client.send.Runtime.evaluate(params={"expression": "1"}, session_id=attached["sessionId"])
440	                    await client.send.Target.detachFromTarget(params={"sessionId": attached["sessionId"]})
441	                return False
442	            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - timeout or a target that vanished: only a timeout counts as hung
443	                return True
444	
445	        verdicts = await asyncio.gather(*(hung(t) for t in pages))
446	        closed: list[str] = []
447	        for target, is_hung in zip(pages, verdicts):
448	            if is_hung:
449	                try:
450	                    await asyncio.wait_for(client.send.Target.closeTarget(params={"targetId": target["targetId"]}), 5)
451	                    _OWNERS.pop(target["targetId"], None)
452	                    closed.append(target["targetId"])
453	                    log.warning("browser %d: closed a hung tab (%s)", browser, str(target.get("url"))[:80])
454	                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
455	                    continue
456	        return closed
457	
458	    if not browsers.cdp_urls():
459	        return []
460	    try:
461	        return await asyncio.wait_for(_with_cdp(browser, probe), TAB_PROBE_S + 15)
462	    except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
463	        log.debug("hung-tab check on browser %d failed: %s", browser, error)
464	        return []

467	async def responsive_tab(tab: "Tab") -> "Tab":
468	    """The tab to work in: `tab` if its browser answers, else a new tab of the next browser that does. Any browser can
469	    open any site, so one dead browser must not take a whole role (or the signing) down with it. A healthy tab of a
470	    browser checked within CHECK_EVERY_S skips the check (it cost every browse a CDP round trip)."""
471	    urls = browsers.cdp_urls()
472	    if not urls:
473	        return tab
474	    if tab.replacement is not None:          # work already moved to another browser: keep using that tab
475	        return await responsive_tab(tab.replacement)
476	    recent = time.monotonic() - _CHECKED.get(tab.browser, -1e9) < CHECK_EVERY_S
477	    if recent and not tab.suspect:
478	        return tab
479	    with timeline.span("recovery", f"check browser {tab.browser}"):
480	        if await browser_responds(tab.browser):
481	            closed = await close_hung_tabs(tab.browser, mine=tab)
482	            if closed:
483	                timeline.count("tabs.hung_closed", len(closed))
484	            else:
485	                _CHECKED[tab.browser] = time.monotonic()
486	            if tab.target_id and tab.target_id in closed:
487	                now = time.monotonic()
488	                recent = [t for t in _HUNG_AT.get(tab.browser, []) if now - t < REPEAT_HANG_S]
489	                _HUNG_AT[tab.browser] = recent + [now]
490	                timeline.count("tabs.replaced")
491	                if recent:            # hung again on this browser (run_db181692d8232b97: twice while signing)
492	                    others = [(len([t for t in _HUNG_AT.get(b, []) if now - t < REPEAT_HANG_S]), b)
493	                              for b in range(len(urls)) if b != tab.browser]
494	                    for _, other in sorted(others):
495	                        if await browser_responds(other):
496	                            log.warning("browser %d hung again: continuing in a new tab of browser %d",
497	                                        tab.browser, other)
498	                            timeline.count("tabs.moved_browser")
499	                            tab.renew()
500	                            tab.replacement = Tab(other)      # closed together with `tab` by its owner
501	                            return tab.replacement
502	                log.warning("browser %d: this agent's tab was hung and closed; continuing in a new tab", tab.browser)
503	                tab.renew()           # same Tab object: its owner still closes it, and a main tab stays the main tab
504	            tab.suspect = False
505	            return tab
506	        for step in range(1, len(urls)):
507	            other = (tab.browser + step) % len(urls)
508	            if await browser_responds(other):
509	                log.warning("browser %d is unreachable: continuing in a new tab of browser %d", tab.browser, other)
510	                timeline.count("tabs.moved_browser")
511	                moved = Tab(other)
512	                tab.replacement = moved         # closed together with `tab` by its owner
513	                return moved
514	    return tab   # none answers: try the original again (the caller's retry logic takes over)

525	    """The tab a target belongs to: its own claim, else the owner of the tab that opened it (popup of a popup too)."""

﻿# Agent improvement plan: speed first, reliability next

The first priority is a faster, better coordinated swarm that gathers and processes more useful information within the scored time limit. Later stages improve answer correctness, recovery and submission reliability.

The current solution already has multiple agents. The opportunity is to make them work together effectively: less waiting, earlier sharing of discoveries, parallel work within slow tasks, and less duplicated effort. Previous implementations are references, not a prescribed solution.

Use each stage below as a separate prompt to the coding agent. The prompts define problems, desired outcomes and ways to test progress. The coding agent should inspect the current system and choose the architecture, tools and implementation that best achieve those outcomes.

## Instructions for every stage

- Implement one stage at a time and keep the agent runnable end to end. Choose a manageable scope with an intermediate result that can be tested.
- Keep changes local. Do not commit, push or make a ranked submission unless explicitly requested.
- Follow the challenge rules: a model chooses navigation and investigation at runtime, use only the provided browsers within the four-browser limit, and never hardcode scenario answers. Never read `.env` or expose keys.
- Compare with the previous working version. Report elapsed time, useful data collected, answer coverage, model usage and submission outcome where available. Faster execution is useful when it preserves or improves the result.
- Use synthetic cases for focused tests and sandbox rehearsals for real workflow validation. Never load historical answers into a scored run. Evaluate against the 20-minute scored budget even when a rehearsal permits longer.

653	class RobustSession(BrowserSession):
654	    """A BrowserSession whose navigation recovers from a tab stuck while loading: stop the old load and retry once.
655	    It works in its own `Tab` (set `_tab` before starting), with focus emulation on: with several windows only one has
656	    the OS focus, and in the others typed text and focus-dependent page scripts did nothing (logins "did not register",
657	    links "did not navigate"). Playwright enables the same emulation on every page for this reason."""
658	
659	    _tab: Any = PrivateAttr(default=None)
660	    _focus_emulated: set = PrivateAttr(default_factory=set)
661	    _dialogs_handled: set = PrivateAttr(default_factory=set)
662	    _state_timeouts: int = PrivateAttr(default=0)
663	    _dialog_tasks: set = PrivateAttr(default_factory=set)
664	    _dialog_pending: dict = PrivateAttr(default_factory=dict)
665	
666	    async def get_browser_state_summary(self, include_screenshot: bool = True, cached: bool = False,
667	                                        include_recent_events: bool = False):
668	        try:
669	            async with asyncio.timeout(30):
670	                state = await super().get_browser_state_summary(
671	                    include_screenshot=include_screenshot, cached=cached, include_recent_events=include_recent_events)
672	            self._state_timeouts = 0
673	            return state
674	        except TimeoutError as error:
675	            self._state_timeouts += 1
676	            raise RuntimeError('Browser state capture timed out after 30s; retry observation before acting') from error
677	
678	    async def connect(self, cdp_url: str | None = None):
679	        await super().connect(cdp_url)
680	        tab, focus = self._tab, self.agent_focus_target_id
681	        if tab is not None and focus and tab.target_id != focus:
682	            alive = {t.target_id for t in _all_page_targets(self.session_manager)}
683	            if tab.target_id not in alive:      # a main tab's first use, or the agent closed its tab: adopt this one
684	                _OWNERS.pop(tab.target_id or "", None)
685	                tab.popups.discard(focus)
686	                tab.claim(focus)
687	        if tab is not None and focus:
688	            await self.get_or_create_cdp_session(focus, focus=True)     # turns focus emulation on for the tab
689	        return self
690	
691	    async def get_or_create_cdp_session(self, target_id=None, focus: bool = True):
692	        session = await super().get_or_create_cdp_session(target_id, focus=focus)
693	        if focus and self._tab is not None:
694	            self._tab.adopt(session.target_id)      # the agent went into a popup of its tab: keep others out
695	        if focus and self._tab is not None and session.session_id not in self._focus_emulated:
696	            self._focus_emulated.add(session.session_id)
697	            try:
698	                await session.cdp_client.send.Emulation.setFocusEmulationEnabled(
699	                    params={"enabled": True}, session_id=session.session_id)
700	            except Exception as error:
701	                log.debug("focus emulation failed: %s", error)
702	        if focus and session.session_id not in self._dialogs_handled:
703	            self._dialogs_handled.add(session.session_id)
704	            await self._handle_dialogs(session)
705	        return session
706	
707	    async def _handle_dialogs(self, session) -> None:
708	        """Accept native JavaScript dialogs (alert, confirm such as "submit binding bid?", beforeunload) in the agent's
709	        tab. browser-use registers this per new tab, but its handler missed the bid wizard's final confirm: the page
710	        then froze, every page script and state read waited for the dialog, and the run ended without an answer."""
711	        root = self._cdp_client_root or session.cdp_client
712	
713	        async def dismiss(event, session_id=None):
714	            kind, message = event.get("type", "alert"), event.get("message", "")
715	            try:
716	                self._closed_popup_messages.append(f"[{kind}] {message}")
717	            except Exception:
718	                pass
719	            log.info("accepting %s dialog: %s", kind, message[:120])
720	            try:
721	                await asyncio.wait_for(root.send.Page.handleJavaScriptDialog(
722	                    params={"accept": kind != "prompt"}, session_id=session_id or session.session_id), 5)
723	                return True
724	            except Exception as error:
725	                log.debug("dialog handling failed: %s", error)
726	                return False
727	
728	        def target_for(session_id):
729	            manager = self.session_manager
730	            return (manager.get_target_id_from_session_id(session_id) if manager and session_id else None) or getattr(session, "target_id", session_id)
731	
732	        def on_closed(event, session_id=None):
733	            target = target_for(session_id or session.session_id)
734	            for key in list(self._dialog_pending):
735	                if key[0] == target:
736	                    self._dialog_pending.pop(key, None)
737	
738	        def on_dialog(event, session_id=None):
739	            # cdp-use awaits async callbacks inside its sole WebSocket receive loop. Waiting for a CDP
740	            # response there prevents that very response from being received and stalls page observation.
741	            key = (target_for(session_id or session.session_id), event.get("type"), event.get("message"))
742	            if key in self._dialog_pending:
743	                return
744	            task = asyncio.create_task(dismiss(event, session_id))
745	            self._dialog_pending[key] = task
746	            self._dialog_tasks.add(task)
747	            def finished(done):
748	                self._dialog_tasks.discard(done)
749	                if done.cancelled() or done.exception() or not done.result():
750	                    if self._dialog_pending.get(key) is done:
751	                        self._dialog_pending.pop(key, None)
752	            task.add_done_callback(finished)
753	        try:
754	            session.cdp_client.register.Page.javascriptDialogOpening(on_dialog)
755	            session.cdp_client.register.Page.javascriptDialogClosed(on_closed)
756	            await session.cdp_client.send.Page.enable(session_id=session.session_id)
757	        except Exception as error:
758	            log.debug("dialog handler not registered: %s", error)
759	
760	    async def _navigate_and_wait(self, url, target_id, timeout=None, wait_until="load"):
761	        try:
762	            return await super()._navigate_and_wait(url, target_id, timeout=timeout, wait_until=wait_until)
763	        except RuntimeError as error:
764	            if "timed out" not in str(error):
765	                raise
766	            log.warning("navigation stuck, stopping the old load and retrying: %s", url)
767	            session = await self.get_or_create_cdp_session(target_id, focus=False)
768	            try:
769	                await asyncio.wait_for(session.cdp_client.send.Page.stopLoading(session_id=session.session_id), 5)
770	            except Exception as stop_error:
771	                log.debug("stopLoading failed: %s", stop_error)
772	            return await super()._navigate_and_wait(url, target_id, timeout=timeout, wait_until=wait_until)

"""Tabs for jobs on any browser: idle browsers take work instead of one site's browser doing it all.

Every site used to own one browser (tender 0, spec 1, ERP 2, mail 3) and ran all its parallel jobs in tabs of that
browser. Tender and spec finish early, so in reh_06531f76ab5f681e two browsers sat idle from minute 3 while eight ERP
tabs shared browser 2 (state-capture timeouts, a hung tab, 17 ERP jobs in 974 s).

`lease(ctx, site_id, prefer=b)` hands out a tab on the least loaded responsive browser, with at most TABS_PER_BROWSER
browses at once per browser (main tabs included). A browser already logged in to the site ("warm") is preferred: a
cold one costs a login, so it counts COLD_COST extra, and only one tab per browser logs in to a site at a time (two
logins in one cookie jar can undo each other). A released tab stays open on its page and goes back to a small pool
per (browser, site): the next job there starts logged in, on the site, without opening a new tab.
"""
import asyncio
import logging
import os
import time
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager

import browsers
from swarm import timeline

log = logging.getLogger("browse")

TABS_PER_BROWSER = int(os.environ.get("SWARM_TABS_PER_BROWSER", "4"))
COLD_COST = 2.0            # a browser that still has to log in to the site counts as this many extra busy tabs
POOL_PER_SITE = 3          # idle tabs kept open per (browser, site)


class TabScheduler:
    def __init__(self):
        self.leased: set = set()                       # tabs handed out and not yet released
        self.warm: set[tuple[int, str]] = set()        # (browser, site id) with a finished job: logged in there
        self.warming: dict[tuple[int, str], int] = {}  # (browser, site id) -> leases still logging in there
        self.idle: dict[tuple[int, str], list] = {}    # (browser, site id) -> released tabs on that site
        self.changed = asyncio.Event()

    @staticmethod
    def browsers() -> int:
        return max(1, len(browsers.cdp_urls()))

    def load(self, browser: int) -> int:
        from swarm.browser_agent import _ACTIVE
        busy = {id(t): t for t in list(_ACTIVE) + list(self.leased)}
        return sum(1 for t in busy.values() if _browser_of(t) == browser)

    def mark_warm(self, browser: int, site_id: str) -> None:
        if site_id:
            self.warm.add((browser, site_id))

    def pick(self, site_id: str, prefer: int | None = None) -> int | None:
        """The browser for a new job on `site_id`, or None when every usable browser is full."""
        from swarm.browser_agent import DEAD_FOR_S, _UNRESPONSIVE
        best, best_score = None, None
        now = time.monotonic()
        for b in range(self.browsers()):
            if now - _UNRESPONSIVE.get(b, -1e9) < DEAD_FOR_S:
                continue
            load = self.load(b)
            if load >= TABS_PER_BROWSER:
                continue
            key = (b, site_id)
            warm = key in self.warm or bool(self.idle.get(key))
            if not warm and self.warming.get(key):
                continue                      # someone is logging in to this site there: wait for it
            score = load + (0 if warm else COLD_COST) - (0.5 if b == prefer else 0)
            if best_score is None or score < best_score:
                best, best_score = b, score
        return best

    async def acquire(self, site_id: str, prefer: int | None = None):
        from swarm.browser_agent import Tab
        while True:
            b = self.pick(site_id, prefer)
            if b is not None:
                break
            self.changed.clear()
            try:                              # loads also change when main-tab browses end: look again each second
                await asyncio.wait_for(self.changed.wait(), 1.0)
            except TimeoutError:
                pass
        key = (b, site_id)
        pooled = self.idle.get(key) or []
        tab = pooled.pop() if pooled else Tab(b)
        if key not in self.warm and not pooled and not tab.used:
            self.warming[key] = self.warming.get(key, 0) + 1
            tab._warming = key
        self.leased.add(tab)
        if b != prefer and prefer is not None:
            timeline.count("tabs.spread")
        return tab

    async def release(self, tab, site_id: str, ok: bool) -> None:
        self.leased.discard(tab)
        key = getattr(tab, "_warming", None)
        if key is not None:
            tab._warming = None
            self.warming[key] = max(0, self.warming.get(key, 0) - 1)
        b = _browser_of(tab)
        reusable = ok and not tab.suspect and tab.replacement is None and tab.target_id is not None
        if ok:
            self.mark_warm(b, site_id)
        pool = self.idle.setdefault((b, site_id), [])
        if reusable and len(pool) < POOL_PER_SITE:
            pool.append(tab)
        else:
            await tab.close()
        self.changed.set()

    @asynccontextmanager
    async def lease(self, site_id: str, prefer: int | None = None):
        tab = await self.acquire(site_id, prefer)
        ok = False
        try:
            yield tab
            ok = True
        finally:
            await self.release(tab, site_id, ok)

    async def close_idle(self) -> None:
        """Close the pooled tabs (signing needs light browsers more than warm ERP tabs)."""
        tabs = [t for pool in self.idle.values() for t in pool]
        self.idle.clear()
        await asyncio.gather(*(t.close() for t in tabs), return_exceptions=True)


def _browser_of(tab) -> int:
    while getattr(tab, "replacement", None) is not None:
        tab = tab.replacement
    return tab.browser


def scheduler(ctx) -> TabScheduler:
    return ctx.shared.setdefault("tab_scheduler", TabScheduler())

"""The tab scheduler spreads jobs over every browser with room, prefers browsers already logged in to the site, lets
only one tab per browser log in to a site at a time, and reuses released tabs; closing tabs never ends a browser."""
import asyncio
import unittest
from unittest import mock

from swarm import browser_agent as ba
from swarm import scheduler as sch


def urls(n=4):
    return mock.patch.object(sch.browsers, "cdp_urls", return_value=[f"http://127.0.0.1:{9000 + i}" for i in range(n)])


class Pick(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        ba._ACTIVE.clear()
        ba._UNRESPONSIVE.clear()

    def tearDown(self):
        ba._ACTIVE.clear()

    def test_full_home_browser_spills_to_the_least_loaded_one(self):
        s = sch.TabScheduler()
        s.warm.update({(2, "erp")})
        busy = [ba.Tab(2) for _ in range(sch.TABS_PER_BROWSER)] + [ba.Tab(0), ba.Tab(3), ba.Tab(3)]
        ba._ACTIVE.update(busy)
        with urls():
            self.assertEqual(s.pick("erp", prefer=2), 1)       # browser 2 full; 1 is idle

    def test_warm_browser_beats_a_cold_one_with_less_load(self):
        s = sch.TabScheduler()
        s.warm.add((2, "erp"))
        ba._ACTIVE.update([ba.Tab(2), ba.Tab(2)])
        with urls():
            self.assertEqual(s.pick("erp"), 2)                 # 2 busy tabs < 0 busy + login cost

    def test_one_login_per_browser_and_site(self):
        async def run():
            s = sch.TabScheduler()
            with urls(2):
                first = await s.acquire("mail", prefer=0)
                second = await s.acquire("mail", prefer=0)
                return first.browser, second.browser
        self.assertEqual(asyncio.run(run()), (0, 1))

    def test_dead_browser_is_skipped(self):
        s = sch.TabScheduler()
        ba._UNRESPONSIVE[1] = __import__("time").monotonic()
        with urls(2):
            self.assertEqual(s.pick("spec", prefer=1), 0)


class Pool(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_released_tab_is_reused_logged_in(self):
        async def run():
            s = sch.TabScheduler()
            with urls():
                async with s.lease("erp", prefer=2) as tab:
                    tab.claim("t-1")
                    tab.used = True
                again = await s.acquire("erp", prefer=2)
                return tab, again, s
        tab, again, s = asyncio.run(run())
        self.assertIs(again, tab)
        self.assertIn((2, "erp"), s.warm)
        ba._OWNERS.pop("t-1", None)

    def test_suspect_tab_is_closed_not_pooled(self):
        closed = []

        async def close(self):
            closed.append(self)

        async def run():
            s = sch.TabScheduler()
            with urls(), mock.patch.object(ba.Tab, "close", close):
                async with s.lease("erp", prefer=2) as tab:
                    tab.claim("t-2")
                    tab.suspect = True
                return tab, s
        tab, s = asyncio.run(run())
        self.assertEqual(closed, [tab])
        self.assertFalse(s.idle.get((2, "erp")))
        ba._OWNERS.pop("t-2", None)


class KeepBrowserOpen(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_closing_the_last_page_opens_a_blank_one_first(self):
        created = []

        class Send:
            class Target:
                @staticmethod
                async def getTargets():
                    return {"targetInfos": [{"targetId": "a", "type": "page"}, {"targetId": "w", "type": "worker"}]}

                @staticmethod
                async def createTarget(params):
                    created.append(params)
                    return {"targetId": "blank"}

        client = mock.Mock(send=Send)
        asyncio.run(ba._keep_browser_open(client, ["a"]))
        self.assertEqual(len(created), 1)
        created.clear()
        asyncio.run(ba._keep_browser_open(client, []))
        self.assertEqual(created, [])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

2	"""Enters the computed bid in the tender portal's submission wizard and signs it with the TAN from the webmail.
3	
4	The model drives the wizard (browser 0) from the brief's submission instructions and a table of the values to enter;
5	`fill_form` sets many fields per step. When the wizard asks for the signing TAN the model calls `get_signing_tan`,
6	which runs a short browse on the mail browser (3) to read the newest TAN mail. Runs even if earlier phases failed:
7	then every position without data is omitted ("partial submission"), the bid is still signed.
8	
9	Time savers (the submission reserve shrinks with them, see swarm.context.submit_reserve):
10	- WizardPrep: near the end of collection the tender portal's main tab logs in and opens the bid wizard (entering
11	  nothing), so the submitter starts at the wizard's first step.
12	- At submit start the TAN lookup starts in standby on the mail browser's main tab: it logs in, passes the gate, opens
13	  the inbox and waits (wait_for_tan_request) until the TAN is requested, then reads it right away. get_signing_tan
14	  long-polls the lookup, so the TAN reaches the wizard the moment it is read.
15	- check_entries compares the summary page with the values to enter in code (one step instead of re-reading pages).
16	"""

"""Navigation + state capture with K agents' sessions on one browser, as the swarm creates them (Tab + TextSession)."""
import asyncio, json, os, subprocess, sys, time, logging, statistics
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
PORT = int(os.environ.get("PORT", "9335"))
URLS = [os.environ[k] for k in ("CHALLENGE_SITE_TENDER_PORTAL_URL", "CHALLENGE_SITE_MAIL_URL", "CHALLENGE_SITE_ERP_URL",
                                "CHALLENGE_SITE_CUSTOMER_PORTAL_URL")]
K = int(os.environ.get("K", "8"))
warn = []
class H(logging.Handler):
    def emit(self, r):
        m = r.getMessage()
        if "readiness timeout" in m or "Initialization timeout" in m: warn.append(m)

async def main():
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        exe = p.chromium.executable_path
    proc = subprocess.Popen([exe, f"--remote-debugging-port={PORT}", "--headless=new", "--no-first-run",
                             f"--user-data-dir={os.environ['TEMP']}/bench/prof{PORT}", "about:blank"],
                            stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
    os.environ["CDP_URLS"] = json.dumps([f"http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}"])
    from swarm import browser_agent as ba
    logging.getLogger("browser_use").addHandler(H())
    print("isolate", ba.ISOLATE_TABS, flush=True)
    try:
        tabs = [ba.Tab(0) for _ in range(K)]
        for t in tabs:
            await t.open()

        async def session_for(tab):
            s = ba.TextSession(cdp_url=f"http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}", keep_alive=True)
            s._tab = tab
            t = time.perf_counter()
            await s.start()
            await s.get_or_create_cdp_session(tab.target_id, focus=True)
            return s, time.perf_counter() - t

        async def work(s, n=4):
            navs, caps = [], []
            for i in range(n):
                t = time.perf_counter()
                await s.navigate_to(URLS[i % len(URLS)])
                navs.append(time.perf_counter() - t)
                t = time.perf_counter()
                await s.get_browser_state_summary(include_screenshot=False)
                caps.append(time.perf_counter() - t)
            return navs, caps

        sess = await asyncio.gather(*(session_for(t) for t in tabs))
        print(f"{K} sessions connect s median {statistics.median([c for _, c in sess]):.2f}; attached per session "
              f"{[len(s.session_manager._session_to_target) for s, _ in sess]}", flush=True)
        res = await asyncio.gather(*(work(s) for s, _ in sess))
        navs = [x for r in res for x in r[0]]; caps = [x for r in res for x in r[1]]

Tab scheduler: parallel jobs run on whichever browser has room

Every site used to own one browser; tender and spec finished early and two browsers sat idle while eight ERP
tabs shared one. swarm/scheduler.py leases tabs on the least loaded browser (4 browses per browser, a browser
already logged in to the site preferred, one login per browser and site at a time, released tabs pooled and
reused). ERP jobs, mail topic tabs, the Q&A tab and coordinator follow-ups use it; ERP pre-warms two tabs and
reads prices/stock of the first candidates next to their record. Sandbox run reh_def25b3b6ab5ef06: q 96.1 in
10:06 (was 18:42 at the same quality).

Also: never close a browser's last page (Chrome quits with it), page scripts bounded to 15 s, a tab keeps its
browser session between browses (SWARM_REUSE_SESSIONS), get_signing_tan checks the summary itself, the TAN
lookup clears a search via the URL, startup milestones and browse.connect spans, commitment material described
in the mail extraction shape, local-run logging that tolerates a reader.
